messages:
lucy: heads-up / PR #9801 broke a few 429 examples in docs/error-ref/429.md. CI shows a snippet runtime error and a dead link. can someone pick this up?

ryan: saw it. failing snippet is the python streaming+trim example; error is KeyError on header name 'retry-after' — runtime now emits 'retry-after-ms'. also link to sdk/python/retries.md 404s.

maya: I reviewed that PR and updated wording, didn't catch the header rename. i'll fix the link.

dev-docs-bot: Build 6233 failed — 1 broken link, 1 snippet failure (docs/error-ref/429.md: snippet 2). https://ci.internal/redwood-docs/6233

lucy: plan: 1) maya fixes link; 2) ryan patches python snippet to normalize headers and update token util import; 3) i will add a short mock-based repro and a tiny table mapping causes -> mitigations.

ryan: proposed python patch: prefer 'retry-after-ms' then fallback to 'retry-after' (seconds -> ms), and wrap parsing in try/except. also switch import from token_utils to tokens.count_tokens. snippet excerpt:

```python
hdr_ms = resp.headers.get('Retry-After-Ms')
hdr_s = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
if hdr_ms:
    wait_ms = int(hdr_ms)
elif hdr_s:
    wait_ms = int(float(hdr_s) * 1000)
else:
    wait_ms = 250 + int(random.random() * 200)
# sleep variant shown for sync/async variants
```

ryan: i'll also add a comment that trimming may not help if the server enforces QPS limits or model size caps.

maya: link fixed and pushed to branch docs/429-linkfix -> PR #9801. ci triggered.

ci-bot: Build 6234 started. Running snippet harness.

ci-bot: Build 6234 failed — lint: code-block language mismatch (async keyword in sync example).

lucy: tweak: include both sync and async snippets and label them. keep examples minimal. i'll add the small cause/mitigation table above the examples for quick triage.

ryan: updated branch with header normalization + sync/async variants + token import path. also switched snippet tests to use docs/tests/mock_server.py so repro is deterministic. pushed to docs/py-429-fix branch.

ci-bot: Build 6235 started.

ci-bot: Build 6235 success — snippets + links green.

lucy: final steps: add CHANGELOG line about tolerant header parsing and token util rename, add a short contributing checklist item to verify runtime header names in SDK snippets.

maya: added CHANGELOG and a note in contributing guide. squashed commits and merged PR #9801.

lucy: thanks everyone. postmortem: small runtime rename + token util refactor caused docs drift. action item: add a quick pre-merge step to run snippet harness locally and grep headers against runtime docs. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
